ai_page.text_004: Delete records after confirmation; delete categories
ai_page.text_019: Please connect me to Synca using its remote MCP server {{value0}} (Streamable HTTP) with OAuth authorization. Use this app's supported MCP installation and connection capabilities; reuse an existing connection instead of adding a duplicate. Guide me through configuration and OAuth authorization inside the app I am currently using: name Synca, server URL {{value1}}, transport Streamable HTTP, authentication OAuth. If you cannot add it directly, say so and guide me step by step through the actual app settings, what to enter, and how to connect, then open the official Synca sign-in and consent page for me to sign in and approve permissions. Do not invent menu paths; if unsure, ask for the app version or current screen. Never ask me to paste passwords, verification codes, or access tokens into chat. Providing instructions does not mean installation succeeded. After connecting, read my 5 most recent Synca records to verify the connection without changing or deleting anything.
ai_page.text_021:
Capture a thought.
Let AI take it further.
ai_page.text_022: Find and organize your records in AI apps that support MCP. Save the conversation’s conclusions back to Synca.
ai_page.text_023: Connect your AI in three steps
ai_page.text_024: AI connections are included with Pro Lifetime.
ai_page.text_025: Copy the instruction below and send it to your AI.
ai_page.text_026: Follow your AI’s guidance to configure and authorize Synca in your current app.
ai_page.text_027: Return to the conversation to find and organize your records.
ai_page.text_030: No sign-in here or API key is needed to start. If your AI cannot add the connection automatically, it will guide you through the required setup. Support depends on the app and version.
ai_page.text_034: “Find my notes about the new project”
ai_page.text_037: AI connections require Pro. Unlock Pro and try again.
ai_page.text_040: Buy Pro once to find, organize and save records in AI conversations. No renewal required.
ai_page.text_045: Sign in to Synca to continue
ai_page.text_047: Authorized AI services receive the content you permit. You can revoke future access, but cannot recall data already read.
ai_page.text_050: This name is supplied by the connecting application. Verify that it is the app you intended to connect.
ai_page.text_052: Authorization lasts up to {{value0}} days and can be revoked at any time. The external AI receives permitted data.
ai_page.text_053: Automatic refresh is supported. Reauthorize after {{value0}} days without refreshing or after one year.
ai_page.text_054: This app did not request automatic refresh. Access expires in 30 days; reconnect with a refresh-enabled configuration.
